policy.runtime_rule: The app reads a checked-in reviewed bank and never scrapes coding platforms at runtime.
policy.content_rule: Problem statements, constraints and examples are independently rewritten around classic concepts. External sites are used for curated-list membership and further study links; proprietary statements and solutions are not copied.
policy.company_claim_rule: Questions are common interview patterns, not claimed as official or exclusive questions from any company.

sources.title: Grind 75 · Tech Interview Handbook
sources.use: Question selection, topic, difficulty and recommended-duration reference; prompts are independently rewritten.

sources.title: Coding interview evaluation rubric
sources.use: Four-dimension practice feedback: communication, problem solving, technical competency and testing.

sources.use: Clarify, explore examples, discuss approach, implement and self-test workflow.
